r.notes: Can we plant more koala trees in this area

First time to ever see a koala and it was deceased. Devastated for these animals. Developers ruthlessly destroying their home. There needs to be law to stop this. Other people stopping took photos. I did not want to take a photo.
Koala was healthy, though close to a dog park and residential area. Sleeping on the lower branches.
